blocks.text: Biror ishni nima maqsadda qilayotganimizni aytish uchun ingliz tilida uchta asosiy vosita bor: **to + fe'l**, **for + ot** va **so that + gap**. Asoslari qizil kitobda o'tilgan (→ qizil kitob, 54-dars): I went out **to buy** bread. Bu darsda ularning farqi va nozik joylari. O'zbekchada maqsad «-ish uchun», «-sin deb», «-gani» bilan ifodalanadi: Non **olgani** chiqdim; Hamma **eshitsin deb** baland gapirdim. O'zbekcha «uchun» ni doim **for** deb tarjima qilish — eng katta xato: ko'pincha uning o'rnida **to** yoki **so that** turadi.

Kishi nima maqsadda harakat qilganini aytishda — **to + fe'l**: I called the bank **to ask** about my card. «for to ask», «for asking» — xato. Rasmiyroq uslubda **in order to** va **so as to** ishlatiladi, ayniqsa inkorda: **in order not to / so as not to** wake the baby. Oddiy «not to» maqsad ma'nosida noaniq eshitiladi, shuning uchun inkor maqsadda **so as not to**, **in order not to** yoki **so that ... won't** ni tanlang.

items.text: Aziz went to the bank **to open** a savings account.
items.translation: Aziz omonat hisobi **ochish uchun** bankka bordi.

items.text: We left at dawn **in order to avoid** the traffic.
items.translation: Tirbandlikka **tushib qolmaslik uchun** tong saharda yo'lga chiqdik.

items.text: She spoke quietly **so as not to wake** the children.
items.translation: U bolalarni **uyg'otib yubormaslik uchun** past ovozda gapirdi.

blocks.text: Ot + to: something to eat, time to think

**to** ot yoki olmoshdan keyin ham keladi va u narsaning **vazifasini** bildiradi: **something to read** (o'qishga biror narsa), **a place to stay** (turar joy), **time to rest** (dam olishga vaqt), **money to buy** a flat. Ba'zan oxirida predlog qoladi: a chair **to sit on**, someone **to talk to**, a pen **to write with**. O'zbekchada ko'pincha «-adigan», «-ishga»: **yeydigan** narsa, **turadigan** joy, **gaplashadigan** odam.

items.text: Have you got anything **to read** on the plane?
Tom needs someone **to talk to** about his problems.
There's no time **to lose** — the train leaves in ten minutes.
items.translation: **Boy beradigan** vaqt yo'q — poyezd o'n daqiqadan keyin jo'naydi.

blocks.text: **for + ot** — maqsad ot bilan ifodalanganda: go out **for a meal**, come **for an interview**, stop **for a coffee**; savolda: What's this money **for**? **for + -ing** esa kishining maqsadini emas, **narsaning vazifasini** bildiradi: This knife is **for cutting** bread; What's this button **for**? — It's **for turning** the volume up. Kishi haqida gapirsak — **to**: I went to the shop **to buy** bread («for buying» emas). **for somebody to do** — harakatni boshqa kishi bajaradi: There are benches **for people to sit** on.

rows: I need a bag **to carry** my laptop.
I left the key **for you to find**.
I'll text you **so that you know**.

items.text: Let's stop at that café **for a quick lunch**.
This app is **for tracking** how much water you drink.
items.translation: Bu ilova qancha suv ichayotganingizni **kuzatish uchun**.

items.text: I've left some soup in the fridge **for you to heat** up later.
items.translation: Keyinroq **isitib olishing uchun** muzlatgichda sho'rva qoldirdim.

blocks.text: so that + can / will / could / would

**so that** dan keyin to'liq gap keladi (ega + fe'l). Uni ishlatamiz: (1) maqsad **boshqa kishiga** tegishli bo'lsa: I'll explain it again **so that everyone understands**; (2) maqsadda **can / could** (imkoniyat) yoki **will / would** bo'lsa: I'm saving money **so that I can** travel; (3) **inkor** maqsadda: Write it down **so that you won't forget**. Asosiy gap hozirgi yoki kelasi zamonda bo'lsa — **can / will**, o'tgan zamonda bo'lsa — **could / would**: She moved closer **so that she could** hear better. Og'zaki nutqda **that** tushib qolishi mumkin: Hurry up **so** we don't miss the bus. O'zbekchada «-sin deb», «-ishi uchun», «-masligi uchun».

items.text: Speak up **so that** everyone at the back **can** hear you.
items.translation: Orqada o'tirganlarning hammasi **eshita olishi uchun** balandroq gapiring.

items.text: I wrote the address down **so that** I **wouldn't forget** it.
Madina moved to London **so that** her son **could** study at a good school.
items.translation: O'g'li yaxshi maktabda **o'qiy olsin deb** Madina Londonga ko'chib ketdi.

rows: I left early **to catch** the train.
I left early **so that I could catch** the train.
I left early **so that my wife could** have the car.
I took a map **so as not to get** lost.
I took a map **so that I wouldn't get** lost.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: (1) «uchun» = for: «I came here for learn English» / «for to learn» → I came here **to learn** English. (2) Kishining maqsadida for + -ing: «I went to the shop for buying bread» → **to buy** bread. (3) so that dan keyin to: «so that I can to rest» → so that I can **rest**. (4) so that dan keyin ega tushib qoladi: «so that can see» → so that **we** can see. (5) «for not to be late» → **so as not to be** late / **so that** I **wouldn't be** late.

Tanlash uchun o'zingizga savol bering. Maqsad — fe'l va egasi bir xilmi? → **to**. Maqsad — otmi? → **for**. Narsa nimaga xizmat qiladi? → **for -ing**. Ega boshqami yoki can / will / inkor kerakmi? → **so that**.

items: **to / in order to** + fe'l — kishining maqsadi: I phoned **to apologise**.
**so as not to / in order not to** + fe'l — inkor maqsad (rasmiyroq): **so as not to disturb** anyone.
ot + **to** + fe'l — narsaning vazifasi: a room **to work in**, something **to drink**.
**for** + ot — maqsad ot bilan: go **for a walk**, come **for an interview**.
**for** + -ing — buyumning vazifasi: a tool **for opening** bottles.
**so that** + can / will / could / would — boshqa ega, imkoniyat yoki inkor maqsad.

examples.title: Purpose with **to**: why people do things
examples.description: Kishining maqsadi — to + fe'l: «...ish uchun». Why ...? savoliga To ... bilan qisqa javob berish ham mumkin.

sentences.text: Bekzod went to the library **to return** the books before the deadline.
sentences.translation: Bekzod muddati o'tmasdan kitoblarni **qaytarish uchun** kutubxonaga bordi.

sentences.text: I'm calling **to ask** whether my parcel has arrived.
sentences.translation: Posilkam kelgan-kelmaganini **so'rash uchun** qo'ng'iroq qilyapman.

sentences.text: Why did you go to Tashkent? — **To renew** my passport.
sentences.translation: Toshkentga nega bording? — Pasportimni **yangilash uchun**.

sentences.text: Many students work in cafés **to pay** for their studies.
sentences.translation: Ko'p talabalar o'qish pulini **to'lash uchun** kafelarda ishlaydi.

sentences.text: She opened the window **to let** some fresh air into the room.
sentences.translation: U xonaga toza havo **kiritish uchun** derazani ochdi.

sentences.text: **To get** a good seat, you need to arrive at least an hour early.
sentences.translation: Yaxshi joy **olish uchun** kamida bir soat oldin kelishingiz kerak.

sentences.text: We stopped in Jizzakh **to fill up** the tank and have a short rest.
sentences.translation: Bakni **to'ldirish** va biroz dam olish **uchun** Jizzaxda to'xtadik.

sentences.text: James has gone to the optician's **to have** his eyes tested.
sentences.translation: Jeyms ko'zini **tekshirtirish uchun** okulistga ketgan.

sentences.text: Did you come all this way just **to tell** me that?
sentences.translation: Shuni **aytish uchun** shuncha yo'l bosib keldingmi?

sentences.text: My grandparents moved to the countryside **to enjoy** a quieter life.
sentences.translation: Buvam va buvim tinchroq hayot **kechirish uchun** qishloqqa ko'chib ketishdi.

examples.title: **in order to** / **so as not to**: formal purpose
examples.description: Rasmiyroq maqsad: in order to, so as to; inkor maqsad: in order not to / so as not to («...maslik uchun»).

sentences.text: The council closed the bridge **in order to carry out** urgent repairs.
sentences.translation: Shahar kengashi shoshilinch ta'mir **o'tkazish maqsadida** ko'prikni yopdi.

sentences.text: We took off our shoes at the door **so as not to make** the carpet dirty.
sentences.translation: Gilamni **iflos qilmaslik uchun** eshik oldida poyabzalimizni yechdik.

sentences.text: **In order to** qualify for the grant, you must be under thirty.
sentences.translation: Grantga **da'vogar bo'lish uchun** o'ttiz yoshdan kichik bo'lishingiz kerak.

sentences.text: Dilnoza left the party early **so as not to miss** the last metro.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza oxirgi metroga **kechikib qolmaslik uchun** ziyofatdan erta ketdi.

sentences.text: The company cut prices **in order to attract** more customers.
sentences.translation: Kompaniya ko'proq xaridor **jalb qilish maqsadida** narxlarni tushirdi.

sentences.text: Please switch off your phones **in order not to disturb** the other passengers.
sentences.translation: Boshqa yo'lovchilarni **bezovta qilmaslik uchun** telefonlaringizni o'chiring.

sentences.text: Scientists froze the samples **so as to keep** them fresh for the tests.
sentences.translation: Olimlar namunalarni sinovlargacha **yangi saqlash maqsadida** muzlatib qo'yishdi.

sentences.text: **In order not to** waste time, let's start without Oliver.
sentences.translation: Vaqtni **bekorga ketkazmaslik uchun** Oliversiz boshlay qolaylik.

sentences.text: Nilufar spoke slowly and clearly **so as to be** understood by everyone.
sentences.translation: Nilufar hammaga **tushunarli bo'lishi uchun** sekin va aniq gapirdi.

sentences.text: Hospitals limit visits in winter **in order to stop** infections from spreading.
sentences.translation: Kasalxonalar qishda yuqumli kasalliklar **tarqalishining oldini olish uchun** tashriflarni cheklaydi.

examples.title: Noun + **to**: something to read, a place to stay
examples.description: Ot / olmosh + to + fe'l — narsaning vazifasi: yeydigan narsa, turadigan joy; ba'zan oxirida predlog qoladi (someone to talk to).

sentences.text: Can you recommend **a good hotel to stay at** in Khiva?
sentences.translation: Xivada **to'xtash uchun** yaxshi mehmonxona tavsiya qila olasizmi?

sentences.text: I'm starving — is there anything **to eat** in the fridge?
sentences.translation: Qornim juda och — muzlatgichda **yeydigan** biror narsa bormi?

sentences.text: Kate needs **more time to finish** her thesis, so she's asked for an extension.
sentences.translation: Keytga dissertatsiyasini **tugatish uchun** ko'proq vaqt kerak, shuning uchun muddatni uzaytirishni so'radi.

sentences.text: We haven't got **enough money to buy** a flat in the centre yet.
sentences.translation: Markazdan kvartira **olishga yetadigan pulimiz** hali yo'q.

sentences.text: Old people who live alone often have **nobody to talk to**.
sentences.translation: Yolg'iz yashaydigan keksalarning ko'pincha **gaplashadigan** hech kimi bo'lmaydi.

sentences.text: Bring **something to write with** — the pens in the hall never work.
sentences.translation: **Yozadigan** biror narsa olib keling — zaldagi ruchkalar hech qachon yozmaydi.

sentences.text: This is **the best place to watch** the sunset in Samarkand.
sentences.translation: Bu Samarqandda quyosh botishini **tomosha qilish uchun** eng yaxshi joy.

sentences.text: Does the library have **a quiet room to study in**?
sentences.translation: Kutubxonada **dars qilish uchun** tinch xona bormi?

sentences.text: After the move, the children had **no friends to play with** for months.
sentences.translation: Ko'chib o'tgandan keyin bolalarning oylab **birga o'ynaydigan** do'stlari bo'lmadi.

sentences.text: Jasur bought **a big bag to carry** his camera equipment around.
sentences.translation: Jasur fotoapparat jihozlarini **olib yurish uchun** katta sumka sotib oldi.

examples.title: **for** + noun: go out for a meal
examples.description: Maqsad ot bilan ifodalanganda — for + ot: for a walk, for an interview; savolda: What ... for? — Nima uchun?

sentences.text: Shall we go out **for a meal** tonight to celebrate?
sentences.translation: Bugun kechqurun bayram qilish uchun **restoranga chiqaylikmi**?

sentences.text: Emma came to Tashkent **for a job interview** with an international bank.
sentences.translation: Emma xalqaro bankdagi **ish suhbati uchun** Toshkentga keldi.

sentences.text: Let's stop **for a coffee** — I can hardly keep my eyes open.
sentences.translation: **Qahva ichgani** to'xtaylik — ko'zlarim yumilib ketyapti.

sentences.text: What did you borrow all that money **for**?
sentences.translation: Shuncha pulni **nima uchun** qarzga olding?

sentences.text: Every evening Grandpa goes **for a walk** along the canal.
sentences.translation: Bobom har kuni kechqurun kanal bo'yida **sayr qilgani** chiqadi.

sentences.text: We're meeting Oliver at the station and then going **for a drink**.
sentences.translation: Oliverni vokzalda kutib olamiz, keyin **biror narsa ichgani** boramiz.

sentences.text: You should go to the dentist **for a check-up** every six months.
sentences.translation: Har olti oyda tish shifokoriga **ko'rikka** borishingiz kerak.

sentences.text: Madina is saving **for a new laptop**, so she rarely eats out.
sentences.translation: Madina **yangi noutbuk uchun** pul yig'yapti, shuning uchun kamdan-kam tashqarida ovqatlanadi.

sentences.text: Why don't you come round **for dinner** on Friday?
sentences.translation: Juma kuni bizga **kechki ovqatga** kelmaysizmi?

sentences.text: Thousands of people queued **for tickets** to the final in Manchester.
sentences.translation: Manchesterdagi finalga **chipta olish uchun** minglab odamlar navbatda turishdi.

examples.title: What is it **for**? Things and their purpose
examples.description: Narsaning vazifasi: for + -ing (yoki to + fe'l). Kishining maqsadi uchun esa for + -ing emas, to + fe'l.

sentences.text: What's this little button **for**? — It's **for resetting** the router.
sentences.translation: Bu kichkina tugma **nima uchun**? — Routerni **qayta ishga tushirish uchun**.

sentences.text: This cream is **for treating** minor burns, not for everyday use.
sentences.translation: Bu krem kichik kuyishlarni **davolash uchun**, har kungi foydalanishga emas.

sentences.text: We use this room **for storing** old furniture and boxes.
sentences.translation: Bu xonani eski mebel va qutilarni **saqlash uchun** ishlatamiz.

sentences.text: A thermometer is an instrument **for measuring** temperature.
sentences.translation: Termometr — haroratni **o'lchash uchun** asbob.

sentences.text: The money in this jar is **for paying** the cleaner.
sentences.translation: Bu bankadagi pul farroshga **to'lash uchun**.

sentences.text: Kate uses her tablet **to read** e-books on the train.
sentences.translation: Keyt poyezdda elektron kitob **o'qish uchun** planshetidan foydalanadi.

sentences.text: These special glasses are **for protecting** your eyes from the sun.
sentences.translation: Bu maxsus ko'zoynaklar ko'zingizni quyoshdan **himoya qilish uchun**.

sentences.text: Is this knife **for cutting** bread or meat?
sentences.translation: Bu pichoq **non kesish uchunmi** yoki go'sht kesish uchunmi?

sentences.text: Bekzod went to the bazaar **to buy** fresh herbs for the soup.
sentences.translation: Bekzod sho'rvaga yangi ko'kat **olgani** bozorga bordi.

sentences.text: Old newspapers are useful **for wrapping** glasses when you move house.
sentences.translation: Uy ko'chganda eski gazetalar stakanlarni **o'rash uchun** asqotadi.

examples.title: **so that** + **can** / **could**
examples.description: so that + can (hozirgi / kelasi) va could (o'tgan zamon) — imkoniyat bilan maqsad: «...a olsin deb», «...a olishi uchun».

sentences.text: Aziz is learning German **so that** he **can** study in Berlin.
sentences.translation: Aziz Berlinda **o'qiy olishi uchun** nemis tilini o'rganyapti.

sentences.text: Could you move your bag **so that** this lady **can** sit down?
sentences.translation: Bu ayol **o'tira olishi uchun** sumkangizni olib qo'ya olasizmi?

sentences.text: We bought a bigger table **so that** the whole family **could** eat together.
sentences.translation: Butun oila birga **ovqatlana olsin deb** kattaroq stol sotib oldik.

sentences.text: I'll send you the files tonight **so that** you **can** check them before the meeting.
sentences.translation: Yig'ilishdan oldin **tekshirib chiqa olishingiz uchun** fayllarni bugun kechqurun yuboraman.

sentences.text: The teacher wrote the words on the board **so that** everyone **could** copy them.
sentences.translation: O'qituvchi hamma **ko'chirib ola olsin deb** so'zlarni doskaga yozdi.

sentences.text: Turn the light on **so that** we **can** see what we're doing.
sentences.translation: Nima qilayotganimizni **ko'ra olishimiz uchun** chiroqni yoqing.

sentences.text: My parents worked hard **so that** we **could** go to university.
sentences.translation: Ota-onam biz universitetda **o'qiy olishimiz uchun** tinmay ishlashdi.

sentences.text: Leave the gate open **so** the delivery driver **can** get in.
sentences.translation: Yetkazib beruvchi **kira olishi uchun** darvozani ochiq qoldiring.

sentences.text: Sarah got up at five **so that** she **could** finish her presentation in peace.
sentences.translation: Sara taqdimotini xotirjam **tugata olishi uchun** soat beshda turdi.

sentences.text: How can we arrange the chairs **so that** everyone **can** see the screen?
sentences.translation: Hamma ekranni **ko'ra olishi uchun** stullarni qanday joylashtirsak bo'ladi?

examples.title: **so that** + **won't** / **wouldn't**: negative purpose
examples.description: so that + will / won't (hozirgi / kelasi) va would / wouldn't (o'tgan) — ayniqsa inkor maqsadda: «...masin deb», «...maslik uchun».

sentences.text: I'll set two alarms **so that** I **won't** oversleep.
sentences.translation: **Uxlab qolmaslik uchun** ikkita budilnik qo'yaman.

sentences.text: Write your name on your cup **so that** nobody **will** take it by mistake.
sentences.translation: Hech kim adashib **olib ketmasin deb** stakaningizga ismingizni yozing.

sentences.text: We whispered **so that** the baby **wouldn't** wake up.
sentences.translation: Chaqaloq **uyg'onib ketmasin deb** pichirlab gaplashdik.

sentences.text: Jasur kept every receipt **so that** he **would** have proof of his expenses.
sentences.translation: Xarajatlarining **isboti bo'lsin deb** Jasur har bir chekni saqlab qo'ydi.

sentences.text: Text me when you arrive **so that** I **won't** worry about you.
sentences.translation: **Xavotir olmasligim uchun** yetib borganingda xabar yoz.

sentences.text: The police closed the road **so that** nobody **would** drive into the flood.
sentences.translation: Hech kim suv bosgan joyga **kirib ketmasin deb** politsiya yo'lni yopdi.

sentences.text: Madina labelled all the boxes **so that** the movers **wouldn't** lose anything.
sentences.translation: Yuk tashuvchilar hech narsani **yo'qotib qo'ymasin deb** Madina barcha qutilarga yorliq yopishtirdi.

sentences.text: Put the milk back in the fridge **so that** it **won't** go off.
sentences.translation: Sut **aynib qolmasin deb** uni muzlatgichga qaytarib qo'y.

sentences.text: I'm telling you now **so that** you **won't** be surprised later.
sentences.translation: Keyin **hayron qolmasligingiz uchun** hozirdan aytib qo'yyapman.

sentences.text: Oliver booked the tickets early **so that** we **would** all sit together.
sentences.translation: Hammamiz birga **o'tirishimiz uchun** Oliver chiptalarni oldindan band qildi.

examples.title: Mixed: **to**, **for** or **so that**?
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: to, in order to, so as not to, for + ot, for + -ing va so that — har birining o'z o'rni.

sentences.text: Dilnoza went to Edinburgh **for a conference** and stayed a few days **to explore** the city.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza Edinburgga **konferensiyaga** bordi va shaharni **aylanish uchun** yana bir necha kun qoldi.

sentences.text: This app is **for learning** vocabulary, and I use it **to prepare** for IELTS.
sentences.translation: Bu ilova lug'at **yodlash uchun**, men esa undan IELTSga **tayyorlanish uchun** foydalanaman.

sentences.text: We moved closer to the stage **so that** we **could** hear the singer better.
sentences.translation: Qo'shiqchini yaxshiroq **eshita olishimiz uchun** sahnaga yaqinroq o'tdik.

sentences.text: Doctors recommend drinking water **in order to avoid** headaches in hot weather.
sentences.translation: Shifokorlar issiq havoda bosh og'rig'ining **oldini olish uchun** ko'p suv ichishni tavsiya qiladi.

sentences.text: I need a quiet place **to work** and some time **to think**.
sentences.translation: Menga **ishlash uchun** tinch joy va **o'ylab olish uchun** biroz vaqt kerak.

sentences.text: Tom left a spare key with his neighbour **for us to collect**.
sentences.translation: Tom biz **olib ketishimiz uchun** qo'shnisiga zaxira kalit qoldirdi.

sentences.text: Why are you going to Fergana? — **For** my cousin's **wedding**.
sentences.translation: Farg'onaga nega ketyapsiz? — Amakivachchamning **to'yiga**.

sentences.text: The government raised taxes **so that** it **could** build more hospitals.
sentences.translation: Hukumat ko'proq shifoxona **qura olishi uchun** soliqlarni oshirdi.

sentences.text: Speak slowly **so as not to** confuse the new students.
sentences.translation: Yangi talabalarni **chalg'itib qo'ymaslik uchun** sekin gapiring.

sentences.text: Nilufar works two jobs **so that** her children **will** have a better future.
sentences.translation: Bolalarining kelajagi yaxshiroq **bo'lsin deb** Nilufar ikki joyda ishlaydi.
